title: Ab Toh Ghazi Ko Do Sada Zainab
body:
Ab Toh Ghazi Ko Do Sada Zainab, Shimar Khaimay May Aah Na Jayay Kahin.
<<DIVIDER>>
Keh Rahee Thee Fizza Yeh Ro Ro Kar,
Ab To Khaimay Bee Jhal Chukay Bibi,
Zulm Zaalim Na Aur Daayay Kahin.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Sakina Na Jaana Maqtal May, Dhoor Say Shimaar Dekhta Hoga
Ab Sakina Na Jaana Maqtal May, Phir Tamachay Nah Yeh Lagaye Kahin.
